title: Paris knife attack: Man arrested after three women stabbed near Porte de Clichy
summary_full: A man was arrested after stabbing three women near Paris's Porte de Clichy on Monday. One victim, believed to be pregnant, is in critical condition after the attack. The 31-year-old suspect, who reportedly has mental health issues, was apprehended at the scene. Police found two knives in the possession of the arrested individual. An investigation into the incident has been officially opened by authorities.
